searchTerms.title: Business types or search terms
searchTerms.description: One to ten business categories or keywords.

location.title: Target location
location.description: City, region and country. Search relevance is not a strict geographic boundary.

maxResults.title: Maximum unique businesses
maxResults.description: Output cap, not a guarantee of result count.

collectEmails.title: Look for public website emails
collectEmails.description: Visits websites; slower and may return no emails. Empty does not prove absence.

language.title: Search language
language.description: Language code, for example en or de.

maxRunSeconds.title: Scraping time limit in seconds
maxRunSeconds.description: Stops collection and preserves delivered results. Allow extra platform time for startup and saving.

depth.title: Search scroll depth
depth.description: Higher depth can increase coverage and runtime.

concurrency.title: Concurrent browser pages
concurrency.description: Start at two with at least 2 GB memory.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify or custom proxies. Proxy availability and charges depend on your account.
